title: Composition of universally normalized ramified reduction balancing
statement: Let l be prime, E, F and L finite extensions of the l-adic field ℚ_l with ℚ_l-algebra maps E → F → L, W a scheme, and SE, SF, SL the specified coefficient derived system calculi. For every M in the derived category of completed E-coefficient modules on W and positive ramification indices e and h, the strict tensor associator followed by the direct E/L reduction balancing equals: tensoring the E/F balancing by L, commuting tensor with e-selection, applying e-selection to the F/L balancing, reassociating the retained levels from h followed by e to h*e, and applying h*e-selection to reduction of the completed tensor associator. This equation is in the derived category of constant L-integral strict towers before any compactification, image functor, support model or inverse limit. The notation is fixed by [lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-composition-prelude], [def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-mates], [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data], [def-pur-strict-scalar-reduction-balancing], [def-pur-native-constant-support-model], [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data], [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data].

proof.text: Compose the ordinary quotient balancings. On local double pure tensors d tensor (b tensor (1 tensor x)), both paths move the scalar factors across the quotient unit and then multiply them according to the tensor associator. Positivity identifies h*(e*(n+1)-1+1)-1 with (h*e)*(n+1)-1. The source generator criterion gives equality of maps on every site object and quotient level, and the transition compatibility of ordinaryBalancing gives the whole-tower equality.

Apply the ordinary equality degreewise. The canonical localization factors for exact constant tensor and arithmetic selection, together with the completedTensorModel_composition and the specified completed tensor adjunction units, identify the source and target counits of the composite. It satisfies the direct reduction-balancing counit equation. Uniqueness in reductionBalancing_existsUnique gives the displayed derived equation on every M. No independently chosen level maps or evaluation faithfulness is used.

theorem reductionBalancing_composition (W : Scheme.{u})
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (SF : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l F W)
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l L W)
    (e h : ℕ) (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e) (hepos : 1 ≤ e)
    (hh : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l F L j h) (hhpos : 1 ≤ h)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E W)) :
    (compositionTower l E F i L j W).hom.app ((reduction l E W SE).obj M) ≫
        (reductionBalancing l E L (j.comp i) W SE SL (h * e)
          (compositionRamification l E F i L j e h he hh)
          (one_le_mul hhpos hepos)).hom.app M =
      (T l F L j W).map ((reductionBalancing l E F i W SE SF e he hepos).hom.app M) ≫
        (compositionSelection l F L j W e).hom.app
          ((reduction l F W SF).obj
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)).obj M)) ≫
        (subsequence l L W e).map
          ((reductionBalancing l F L j W SF SL h hh hhpos).hom.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)).obj M)) ≫
        (compositionRetained l L W e h hepos hhpos).hom.app
          ((reduction l L W SL).obj
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l F L j W)).obj
              ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)).obj M))) ≫
        (subsequence l L W (h * e)).map
          ((reduction l L W SL).map ((compositionCompleted l E F i L j W).hom.app M))
